behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Sparse JSON round trip with numerical order and stored null versus absence.
docDelivery: Coordinate domain, numerical ordering, deep-copy ownership and absent/null semantics.
Exact persisted cell shape, replacement restore, parse/validation errors and unchanged state on failure.

complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: row/column integers -1000..1000 (negative zero treated as zero); cell value JSON primitives/ordinary records/dense arrays excluding undefined/custom methods/getters/cycles/nonfinite numbers/-0 in values. Restore text JSON or malformed, valid snapshot cell objects exact row,column,value keys, duplicate coordinates rejected.
independence: Implement sparse matrix coordinate encoding, zero elision and rectangular dimensions through save/load.
